==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
It is really late at night. I am hanging out with a group of friends in a strange, large vehicle. I demand that we all go home, because I am starting to get a bad feeling.

The vehicle driver offers us the opportunity to work for him. We refuse his offer. We head upstairs to our apartment to get some rest.

The driver's goons follow us into our apartment and refuse to leave. A fight breaks out as we try to get the goons to leave. One of the goons, resembling a clown, says that the driver cursed us as I start to wake up.
